name: Validate Email
description: Is this an email address? Answers { valid, value } with the address in lower case, or { valid: false, reason } — for a sign-up form, a contact record, an invite, an imported list.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const s = String(email ?? '').trim(); return /^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]{2,}$/.test(s) ? { valid: true, value: s.toLowerCase() } : { valid: false, reason: 'Not an email address' }; })() }}"}]
